items.title: Biogeochemical cycles ke primary reservoirs (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of primary reservoirs (PDF 230).

blocks.text: Primary reservoir ('sink' ya 'pool') biosphere ka bara hissa hai jahan biogeochemical cycle ka unsar lambe arse tak jama rehta hai. Primary reservoir ke lehaaz se cycles ki do qismein hain.

blocks.caption: Biogeochemical cycles ki qismein
rows: nitrogen, oxygen, carbon aur paani ke cycles
phosphorus, sulfur aur calcium ke cycles

blocks.prompt: Phosphorus cycle gaseous hai ya sedimentary?
blocks.explanation: Sedimentary: is ka reservoir zameen ki parat hai.

items: Gaseous cycles: reservoir hawa ya samandar (N, O, C, paani).
Sedimentary cycles: reservoir parat mein (P, S, Ca).
